marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF860B Cordless High Torque Impact Driver features a 20 V brushless motor, a 1/4 in Quick-Connect Hex chuck, and a variable speed trigger for precise control. With a torque rating of 1500 in-lb and a speed rating of 0 to 3800 RPM, this tool is suitable for a variety of applications. The LED light and compact design also make it ideal for use in dark workspaces.
